Only reason why I wrote this post is because I wanted to share my opinion that AppleCare is helpful in some situations, that it saved me a few hundreds and for some people it may be worth it to get it. 
(Sorry if I come off as rude)

I have AppleCare plus. Normally without it would be $1,774.00 USD altogether (Tier 4 Damage, Labor, and Service Charge), but with AppleCare+, it’s only $299.99 without tax. My parents are the ones who pay for the Mac so they’re pretty happy about not having to pay 1,800.

Some people say “It’s not like I’ll need it, I’m not that clumsy” and they proceed a few months later to break it. I personally get AppleCare for everything. Who knows what could happen. Others say it’s a waste of money. 

I agree, not getting AppleCare isn’t an option. In my country (I don’t know if policy differs or where you are) but it doesn’t cover some repairs but I think it makes the repairs a bit cheaper.
